_README: Hand-owned identity decisions (features/POI_IDENTITY.md, #672) -
reconcile_poi_identity.py READS this file and never writes it, the
same split sources.json keeps between discovered and hand-added
entries. Machine-owned ledger, human-owned overrides.
`same`: this ledger id and this upstream key are the same physical
place - carried before any scoring, and the one door back in for a
retired row (the tombstone re-unites with its successor and every
anchored photo and note comes back).
`not_same`: forbid a pair the evidence matcher would otherwise
consider - ATC's own data holds lookalikes (Rocky Run Shelters 1 and
2) that must never merge.
`merged_into`: upstream folded this retired place into another one, so
everything anchored to it re-anchors there (#673). Rows carry `id`,
`into` (the ledger id of the survivor, which must be LIVE) and
`reason`. The matcher writes this edge itself when a retiring row
cleared the full acceptance bar on a record another id carried; this
is for the merge it could not see, and for correcting one it saw
wrongly. An edge that names a live row, a row this ledger never held,
or a successor that is itself retired HOLDS the run rather than being
skipped.
Every `same`/`not_same` row carries: id (the ledger id), source,
source_feature_id (upstream's CURRENT key), and reason (a sentence a
reviewer can disagree with). A `same` row whose key the snapshot does
not leave unmatched is STALE and holds the run - remove it once it has
done its work; the ledger's history keeps the record.
